text.EN: We can take them.
text.TL: Kaya natin sila.

text.EN: We've handled worse. Let's clear them.
text.TL: Nakalusot na tayo sa mas malala. Ubusin natin sila.

text.EN: Stand firm. We fight through.
text.TL: Tumayo nang matatag. Lalabanan natin sila.

text.EN: We have the weapons. Let's put them down.
text.TL: Nasa atin ang armas. Patumbahin natin sila.

text.EN: Ready up. We're not running from this.
text.TL: Humanda ka. Hindi natin tatakbuhan ito.

text.EN: We take the fight to them. Stay sharp.
text.TL: Sasalubungin natin sila. Maging alerto.

text.EN: Line them up. We can win this.
text.TL: Pilahin sila. Kayang-kaya natin ito.

text.EN: No backing down. We push through.
text.TL: Walang atrasan. Babasagin natin 'to.

text.EN: We hold here and eliminate the threat.
text.TL: Dito tayo tatayo at aalisin ang banta.

text.EN: I'm ready. Let's make every strike count.
text.TL: Handa na ako. Tiyaking may tama ang bawat palo.

text.EN: I'm with you. We can take them.
text.TL: Kasama mo ako. Kaya natin sila.

text.EN: Together, nothing can stop us! Let's do this.
text.TL: Kapag magkasama tayo, walang makapipigil sa atin! Tara na.

text.EN: I've got your back, friend. We fight as one.
text.TL: Hawak ko ang likod mo, kaibigan. Iisang laban tayo.

text.EN: We survive together, we fight together. Let's clear them out!
text.TL: Sabay tayong nabubuhay, sabay tayong lalaban. Ubusin natin sila!

text.EN: With you beside me, I'm not afraid. Let's take them down.
text.TL: Dahil katabi kita, hindi ako natatakot. Patumbahin natin sila.

text.EN: Let's show them what real survivors are made of!
text.TL: Ipakita natin sa kanila kung ano ang tunay na nakaligtas!

text.EN: Right by your side, partner. We won't lose today.
text.TL: Nasa tabi mo lang ako, kasama. Hindi tayo matatalo ngayon.

text.EN: I trust us. Let's stand tall and fight.
text.TL: Tiwala ako sa atin. Tumindig tayo at lumaban.

text.EN: We've got this, friend. Watch my back and I'll watch yours.
text.TL: Kayang-kaya natin, kaibigan. Bantayan ang isa't isa.

text.EN: Stay close and hit hard! We'll celebrate after.
text.TL: Manatiling dikit at humampas nang malakas! Magdiriwang tayo mamaya.

text.EN: Stand and fight.
text.TL: Tumayo at lumaban.

text.EN: We take them.
text.TL: Kaya natin sila.

text.EN: No retreat.
text.TL: Walang urungan.

text.EN: Draw weapons.
text.TL: Bunot ng armas.

text.EN: Kill them all.
text.TL: Ubusin sila.

text.EN: Fight through.
text.TL: Lumaban pasulong.

text.EN: Ready.
text.TL: Handa.

text.EN: Holding ground.
text.TL: Hawak ang pwesto.

text.EN: Let's do this.
text.TL: Gawin na natin.

text.EN: Bring them on.
text.TL: Ilabas sila.

text.EN: If we commit, we hit hard and stay together.
text.TL: Kung lalaban tayo, sabay at todo ang tira.

text.EN: No heroics. Funnel them into a choke point and execute.
text.TL: Walang magpapakabayani. Ipitin sila sa sikip at tapusin.

text.EN: Watch your stamina. Don't swing wild and get exhausted.
text.TL: Bantayan ang lakas. Huwag magwala para di kapusin ng hangin.

text.EN: Keep the line tight. If one falls, we both die.
text.TL: Higpitan ang pormasyon. Kapag may bumagsak, patay tayong dalawa.

text.EN: Target the leaders first. Clear them systematically.
text.TL: Unahin ang mga nasa harap. Ubusin nang may sistema.

text.EN: We fight, but maintain an escape route behind us.
text.TL: Lalaban tayo, pero tiyaking may takasan sa likod natin.

text.EN: Every strike must be lethal. No wasted energy.
text.TL: Bawat tama dapat nakamamatay. Walang sayang na lakas.

text.EN: Don't let them surround us. Push when I push.
text.TL: Huwag magpapaligid sa kanila. Sumulong kapag sumulong ako.

text.EN: We can win this if we keep cool heads and steady hands.
text.TL: Mananalo tayo kung mananatiling malamig ang ulo at matatag ang kamay.

text.EN: Agreed. Take out the front rank and hold the doorway.
text.TL: Sang-ayon. Patumbahin ang unahan at hawakan ang pinto.
